# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper and manager at Grey Shutters

## Appearance

Thirza is a stern woman whose expression softens only rarely. Her countenance is marked by a rigid and severe exterior.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012)_

## Personality

Thirza is a stern, unsentimental, and rigid authority figure who insists on strict domestic order, tidiness, and compliance. Despite her severe manner, sharp scoldings, and reluctance to allow imaginative pretense, she holds a deep underlying concern for those under her care. She does not hesitate to speak her mind firmly or enforce discipline when rules are broken.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v2 c17 P29](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0029), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031)_

## Traits

- Stern and unsentimental  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>
- Pragmatic and plain-spoken  <sub>[v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019)</sub>
- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c9 P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), [v2 c17 P29](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0029), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031)</sub>

## Abilities

- Managing household chores and cooking  <sub>[v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v2 c17 P52](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0052)</sub>

## Goals

- To enforce obedience and proper upbringing for the children in her care  <sub>[v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031)</sub>

## History

Thirza resided at Grey Shutters with her brother Obed Abernethy when they arranged for a child to be brought to them from an asylum. Expecting a boy, she was surprised when Nell Harcourt arrived instead. Despite the mistake, Thirza and Obed agreed to retain Nell, with Thirza supervising her daily tasks and enforcing strict domestic discipline while sending her to school. When Mrs. Agatha Sowerby harshly insulted Nell's appearance, Thirza punished Nell for her explosive outburst but unexpectedly stood up to Agatha, telling her she had been overly harsh. Thirza later agreed to let Nell attend the local Debating Club concert after Obed persistently advocated for her. When Robin Farrow accidentally ruined the lemon pies prepared for visitors by stepping on them against orders, Thirza strictly sent him to his room for his disobedience.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v1 c19 P19](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0019), [v1 c19 P26](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0026), [v1 c19 P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c17 P29](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0029), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031)_
